headings: RED ZARA TEMPTATION TOBACCO EXTRAIT DE PARFUM

jsonld_raw.name: RED ZARA TEMPTATION TOBACCO EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 50ML (1.7 FL. OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
RED ZARA TEMPTATION TOBACCO EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 50ML (1.7 FL. OZ). A highly concentrated extrait de parfum where the Red Zara Temptation accord is transformed by the intensity of tobacco. A dark and spicy tobacco accord provides depth, enhanced by the vibrant freshness of pink pepper and saffron. Sambac jasmine introduces floral luminosity while cistus adds a resinous nuance, reinforcing the warm and enveloping trail.

Woody Gourmand | Dark, warm, and seductive
